explanation: The statement is about the library's own definitions: tensorKunneth, tensorSecond, ExternalTensor.coefficientSecond, extClass3, and the AbsoluteBar 3-cocycle construction for the Auslander–Reiten setting. It says how the second tensor-factor Ext-class action on Ext(M⊗N, M⊗N) corresponds to the Künneth map. Mathlib has no Künneth map for Ext of external tensor products, and no Hochschild-type 3-cocycle classes. The proof is also library-internal: it unfolds the definitions and applies the library's own `nativeTensorSecond_action`. I did not run a search of Mathlib, so none_found rests on that reading of the statement alone.
